units.source_text: 源氏公子知道这里无人看见，便自由自在地走了进去，呼唤大辅命妇。

en.t: Prince Genji knew that no one could see him there, so he walked in freely and called for Taifu no Myobu.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇装作刚知道而吃惊的样子，对小姐说：“怎么办呢？

en.t: Taifu no Myobu pretended to be startled, as if she had only just learned of it, and said to the young lady, "What shall we do?

units.source_text: 他常常埋怨我不替他讨回信，我一直拒绝他说：‘这不是我能够做到的事情。’

en.t: He often reproaches me for not getting a reply for him, and I have always refused him, saying, 'That is not something I can do.'

units.source_text: 他总是说：‘既然如此，让我自己去向小姐诉说吧！’

en.t: He is always saying, 'In that case, let me go and plead with the young lady myself!'
How are we to send him away now?

units.source_text: ……他不是一般的轻薄少年，不理睬他是不好意思的。

en.t: ...He is not an ordinary frivolous young man, and it would be awkward to ignore him.

units.source_text: 您隔着帘子听他讲讲吧。”

en.t: Please listen to what he has to say from behind the curtain."

units.source_text: 小姐十分害羞，狼狈地说：“我不会应酬客人的呀！”

en.t: The young lady was terribly shy and said in confusion, "I do not know how to receive visitors!"

units.source_text: 只管退向里面去，竟像个小孩。

en.t: She kept retreating farther inside, just like a child.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇看了笑起来，便劝导她：“您这样孩子气，真要命！

en.t: Seeing this, Taifu no Myobu laughed and admonished her, "It is really hopeless for you to be so childish!

units.source_text: 不管身份何等高贵，在有父母教养的期间，孩子气还有理可说。

en.t: No matter how noble one's rank may be, childishness can still be excused while one is being raised and guided by one's parents.

units.source_text: 如今您孤苦无依，还是这么不懂世故，畏首畏尾，太不成样子了。”

en.t: But now that you are alone and without support, it is most unbecoming to remain so ignorant of the world and so timid."

units.source_text: 小姐生性不愿拒绝别人的劝告，便答道：“如果不要我回答，只要听他讲讲，那么把格子窗关起来，隔着窗子相会吧。”

en.t: The young lady was by nature unwilling to reject another person's advice, so she answered, "If I need not reply and only have to listen, then close the lattice window and let us meet through it."

units.source_text: 大辅命妇说：“教他站在廊上，是不成体统的。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu said, "It would be improper to make him stand out in the corridor.

units.source_text: 他决不会轻举妄动，您放心吧。”

en.t: He would never behave rashly, so please be at ease."

units.source_text: 她花言巧语地说服了小姐，便亲自动手，把内室和客室之间的纸隔扇关上，又在客室铺设了客人的座位。

en.t: With skillful words she persuaded the young lady, then set to work herself, closing the paper sliding doors between the inner room and the guest room and arranging a seat for the visitor in the guest room.
